items.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019
items.q: My dad was a country & western guitar player. Instead of being Peter Chez he was called Chet Peters cause it sounded more country.

ctx.x: Can I assume that your parents gave a blessing to your musical path?
Yeah. My dad was a country & western guitar player. Instead of being Peter Chez he was called Chet Peters cause it sounded more country. He met my mom, my mom sang

background in one of his bands at a bar in Jersey City, New Jersey. I started doing, like I said before, the drum & bugle corps activity. They started at the local church where I grew up, my dad, okay, my dad snuck in, my dad lived in Jersey City, New Jersey. They had this big drum & bugle marching band show in Jersey City called the Dream Contest every year. When my dad was like 15, 16 years old him and his buddies hopped the fence and snuck into the stadium, probably to cause trouble, as 15, 16 year old kids…
